title: 飛行時間質譜儀~Time-of-flight mass spectrometers
focus: 飛行時間方程、解析力、反射器能量聚焦、MCP 與 TDC 計時、質量校正與正交加速工作週期~Flight-time equation, resolving power, reflectron energy focusing, MCP and TDC timing, mass calibration and orthogonal-acceleration duty cycle
summary: 從同一電位加速後離子速度與質量平方根成反比出發，理解飛行時間質譜儀如何把質量量測轉成奈秒級計時，再把初始能量散布、反射器聚焦、微通道板偵測、時間數位轉換、溫度與高壓漂移造成的 ppm 誤差、MALDI 與 ESI 的離子注入整合成可驗收的質量量測鏈。~Start from the fact that ions accelerated through one potential travel at speeds inversely proportional to the square root of mass to see how a time-of-flight mass spectrometer turns mass measurement into nanosecond timing, then integrate initial energy spread, reflectron focusing, microchannel-plate detection, time-to-digital conversion, ppm errors from temperature and high-voltage drift, and MALDI and ESI ion injection into an acceptable mass-measurement chain.

units.anchor: 加速區與無場漂移管~Acceleration region and field-free drift tube
units.title: 飛行時間方程與質量尺度~The flight-time equation and the mass scale
units.mechanism: 離子在電位差 U 中加速後獲得動能 zeU = ½mv²，進入長度 L 的無場漂移管等速飛行，到達偵測器的時間 t = L·√(m/(2zeU))，所以飛行時間與 √(m/z) 成正比。一次脈衝就讓所有質量同時出發，輕離子先到、重離子後到，偵測器只要記錄整段時間序列就得到完整質譜，這是飛行時間儀器沒有掃描、理論上質量範圍不受限的原因。代價是質量差距被壓縮成時間差：相鄰整數質量在高質量端只差數奈秒，整台儀器的本質是一個精密的碼表。~An ion accelerated through a potential difference U gains kinetic energy zeU = ½mv², then coasts through a field-free drift tube of length L and reaches the detector at t = L·√(m/(2zeU)), so flight time scales with √(m/z). One pulse launches all masses together, light ions arriving first and heavy ions later, and recording the whole time trace yields a complete spectrum, which is why time-of-flight instruments need no scanning and have an essentially unlimited mass range. The price is that mass differences are compressed into time differences: adjacent integer masses at high mass differ by only a few nanoseconds, so the instrument is at heart a precision stopwatch.
units.model: 線性 MALDI-TOF 取 U = 20 kV、L = 1.0 m：m/z 1000 的速度 v = √(2×1.602×10⁻¹⁹×2×10⁴/(1000×1.6605×10⁻²⁷)) ≈ 6.21×10⁴ m/s，t = 1.0/6.21×10⁴ ≈ 16.10 µs；m/z 1001 晚到 8.05 ns；m/z 100 只要 5.09 µs，m/z 3000 為 27.9 µs。因此若要在 m/z 1000 分開相差 1 Da 的峰，計時誤差必須遠小於 8 ns，而每 27.9 µs 就能完成一次 m/z 3000 以下的全譜。~For a linear MALDI-TOF with U = 20 kV and L = 1.0 m, an m/z 1000 ion travels at v = √(2×1.602×10⁻¹⁹×2×10⁴/(1000×1.6605×10⁻²⁷)) ≈ 6.21×10⁴ m/s and arrives at t = 1.0/6.21×10⁴ ≈ 16.10 µs; m/z 1001 arrives 8.05 ns later, m/z 100 needs only 5.09 µs and m/z 3000 needs 27.9 µs. Separating peaks 1 Da apart at m/z 1000 therefore needs timing errors far below 8 ns, while a full spectrum up to m/z 3000 is complete every 27.9 µs.
units.verify: 以已知質量的校正混合物取線性模式頻譜，記錄各峰的飛行時間，畫 t 對 √(m/z) 的圖應為直線，截距即電子與觸發延遲 t₀；改變加速電壓 ±5%，確認 t 依 1/√U 變化；以示波器在偵測器輸出端直接量相鄰同位素峰的時間間隔並與上式比較。~Acquire a linear-mode spectrum of a calibration mixture of known masses, plot flight time against √(m/z) and confirm a straight line whose intercept is the electronic and trigger delay t₀; change the acceleration voltage by ±5% and confirm that t scales as 1/√U; measure the time spacing of adjacent isotope peaks directly at the detector output with an oscilloscope and compare with the formula.
units.failure: 把質量與時間當成線性關係做內插，或忽略觸發延遲 t₀，整個質量軸在高低端各自彎曲，低質量碎片與高質量前驅物的指認同時出錯；漂移管的屏蔽網破損或絕緣表面帶電讓區域不再無場，離子速度在途中改變，峰形拖尾且位置隨使用時間漂移。~Interpolating mass as linear in time or ignoring the trigger delay t₀ bends the mass axis differently at the low and high ends, mis-assigning both low-mass fragments and high-mass precursors; a damaged screening mesh or charged insulating surfaces leave the drift tube no longer field-free, changing ion speed in flight so peaks tail and wander with use.
units.misconception: 飛行時間與質量成正比，質量加倍時間也加倍。~Flight time is proportional to mass, so doubling the mass doubles the time.

units.anchor: 離子起始位置與能量散布~Initial ion position and energy spread
units.title: 解析力與初始分布~Resolving power and initial distributions
units.mechanism: 解析力 m/Δm = t/(2Δt)，因為 m ∝ t²，時間的相對展寬會加倍成質量的相對展寬。Δt 來自多個獨立來源：離子形成位置與時間不同、初始速度與能量散布、雷射脈衝寬度、偵測器與電子計時抖動，各項以平方和相加。線性模式中能量散布 ΔU/U 直接造成 Δt/t = ½·ΔU/U，通常是最大項；1955 年 Wiley 與 McLaren 以雙段加速場做空間聚焦，並提出延遲萃取的前身「時間延遲聚焦」，讓位置與速度相關的散布在偵測器處互相抵消。MALDI 以 100–300 ns 的延遲萃取處理雷射羽流的初速分布，但無法消除所有能量散布。~Resolving power is m/Δm = t/(2Δt) because m ∝ t², so a relative time spread doubles into a relative mass spread. Δt comes from independent contributions added in quadrature: differences in formation position and time, initial velocity and energy spread, laser pulse width, and detector and electronic timing jitter. In linear mode an energy spread ΔU/U produces Δt/t = ½·ΔU/U directly and is usually the largest term; in 1955 Wiley and McLaren used a two-stage acceleration field for space focusing and introduced time-lag focusing, the forerunner of delayed extraction, so position- and velocity-correlated spreads cancel at the detector. MALDI uses 100–300 ns of delayed extraction to handle the initial velocity distribution of the laser plume, but cannot remove every energy spread.
units.model: 沿用 t = 16.10 µs 的線性儀器：殘餘能量散布 0.2% 給 Δt = 16.10 µs × 0.1% = 16.1 ns，雷射脈衝 3 ns、數位化 1 ns、偵測器 0.5 ns，總 Δt = √(16.1² + 3² + 1² + 0.5²) ≈ 16.4 ns，R = 16 100/(2×16.4) ≈ 490。若能量項完全消除，Δt = √(3² + 1² + 0.5²) ≈ 3.2 ns，R ≈ 2500。能量散布是線性模式的主因，這正是需要反射器的理由。~For the linear instrument with t = 16.10 µs, a residual energy spread of 0.2% gives Δt = 16.10 µs × 0.1% = 16.1 ns; with a 3 ns laser pulse, 1 ns digitisation and 0.5 ns detector response the total is Δt = √(16.1² + 3² + 1² + 0.5²) ≈ 16.4 ns and R = 16 100/(2×16.4) ≈ 490. Removing the energy term entirely leaves Δt = √(3² + 1² + 0.5²) ≈ 3.2 ns and R ≈ 2500. Energy spread dominates linear mode, which is exactly why a reflectron is needed.
units.verify: 以同一胜肽標準在不同延遲萃取時間（例如 50、150、300 ns）與脈衝電壓下量測解析力，找出最佳組合並確認最佳點隨質量移動；以快速光二極體量雷射脈衝寬度、以 MCP 單離子脈衝量偵測器時間響應，把各項代入平方和預算，與實測峰寬比較找出主導項。~Measure resolving power on one peptide standard at several delayed-extraction times (for example 50, 150 and 300 ns) and pulse voltages, find the best combination and confirm that the optimum shifts with mass; measure the laser pulse width with a fast photodiode and the detector time response from single-ion MCP pulses, insert each term into the quadrature budget and compare with the measured peak width to identify the dominant term.
units.failure: 延遲萃取只針對 m/z 1500 最佳化，使用者量 m/z 5000 的蛋白片段時峰寬變成三倍，同位素包絡無法解析而錯判電荷與單一同位素質量；雷射能量過高使羽流初速與能量散布變大，解析力明顯下降，卻被誤以為是偵測器老化。~Optimising delayed extraction only for m/z 1500 triples the peak width when users measure protein fragments near m/z 5000, so isotope envelopes cannot be resolved and charge state and monoisotopic mass are misassigned; excessive laser fluence enlarges the plume's initial velocity and energy spread and visibly lowers resolving power, which is wrongly blamed on detector ageing.
units.misconception: 只要漂移管夠長，解析力就可以無限提高。~Make the drift tube long enough and resolving power rises without limit.

units.anchor: 反射器減速場~Reflectron retarding field
units.title: 反射器的能量聚焦~Energy focusing in the reflectron
units.mechanism: 反射器是一組逐級升壓的環形電極，形成略高於加速電位的減速場；能量較高的離子跑得快，但穿入反射場較深、在裡面待較久，能量較低的離子路徑較短，兩者在偵測器處同時到達。1973 年 Mamyrin 提出此設計。單段均勻場反射器的一階能量聚焦條件是總無場長度 L 等於穿透深度 d 的四倍；雙段反射器以前段大幅減速、後段反射，可縮短長度並聚焦到二階。代價是柵網造成散射與穿透損失，以及離子必須走入反射場而限制了最大可接受的能量範圍。~A reflectron is a stack of ring electrodes graded in voltage to form a retarding field slightly above the acceleration potential; faster, higher-energy ions penetrate deeper and spend longer inside, slower ions take a shorter path, and both reach the detector together. Mamyrin proposed the design in 1973. A single-stage uniform-field reflectron achieves first-order energy focusing when the total field-free length L equals four times the penetration depth d; a two-stage reflectron decelerates strongly in the first stage and reflects in the second, shortening the device and focusing to second order. The costs are scattering and transmission loss on grids and a limited accepted energy window, since every ion must turn around inside the field.
units.model: 單段反射器 t(K) = L/v + 2mv/(qE)，令 dt/dK = 0 得 L = 4d。取 U = 20 kV、L = 0.8 m、d = 0.2 m（E = 100 kV/m）：m/z 1000 總飛行時間 (0.8 + 4×0.2)/6.21×10⁴ ≈ 25.75 µs。能量 ±0.5% 時線性管的 Δt/t 為 ±0.25%（R ≈ 100），反射器只剩二階殘差 3.1×10⁻⁶，能量項的解析力上限約 1.6×10⁵；此時若其他計時項總和 0.6 ns，R = 25 750/(2×0.6) ≈ 21 500。~A single-stage reflectron has t(K) = L/v + 2mv/(qE), and setting dt/dK = 0 gives L = 4d. With U = 20 kV, L = 0.8 m and d = 0.2 m (E = 100 kV/m), the total flight time for m/z 1000 is (0.8 + 4×0.2)/6.21×10⁴ ≈ 25.75 µs. For a ±0.5% energy spread a linear tube has Δt/t of ±0.25% (R ≈ 100), while the reflectron leaves only a second-order residual of 3.1×10⁻⁶, an energy-limited resolving power near 1.6×10⁵; if the remaining timing terms total 0.6 ns, R = 25 750/(2×0.6) ≈ 21 500.
units.verify: 以固定樣品掃描反射器電壓比例，記錄峰寬與到達時間對電壓的曲線，最佳點應與 L = 4d（或雙段的設計值）預測一致；故意以加速電位 ±1% 改變離子能量，確認到達時間變化遠小於線性模式的 0.5%；以多個質量確認聚焦條件與質量無關。~Scan the reflectron voltage ratio on a fixed sample and record peak width and arrival time against voltage, expecting the optimum predicted by L = 4d or by the two-stage design; deliberately change ion energy by ±1% through the acceleration potential and confirm that the arrival time changes far less than the 0.5% of linear mode; check at several masses that the focusing condition is mass-independent.
units.failure: 反射器柵網變形或某一級分壓電阻漂移，場不再均勻，峰形出現肩部與拖尾，解析力只剩一半；MALDI 中後源衰變產生的碎片能量低於母離子，無法在反射器中正確聚焦，在譜上形成寬而偏移的假峰，被誤判為未知成分。~A warped reflectron grid or a drifting divider resistor in one stage makes the field non-uniform, adding shoulders and tails to peaks and halving resolving power; in MALDI, post-source-decay fragments carry less energy than their precursors and are not focused correctly by the reflectron, appearing as broad, displaced false peaks that are mistaken for unknown components.
units.misconception: 反射器的作用只是把飛行路徑折返，讓儀器變短。~A reflectron merely folds the flight path to make the instrument shorter.

units.anchor: 微通道板與時間數位轉換器~Microchannel plate and time-to-digital converter
units.title: MCP 偵測器與計時電子~MCP detector and timing electronics
units.mechanism: 到達的離子撞擊微通道板，通道內壁放出二次電子並在數 kV 偏壓下倍增，雙片 V 形堆疊的增益約 10⁶，輸出脈衝寬度小於 1 ns。脈衝可由時間數位轉換器（TDC）以 25–100 ps 的時間格記錄單一離子事件，或以每秒數 GS 的類比數位轉換器（ADC）記錄完整波形並累加；TDC 計時精細、雜訊低，但每個時間格每次脈衝只能計一次，ADC 動態範圍較大卻有基線雜訊。MCP 的偵測效率取決於離子撞擊速度，重離子速度低時效率明顯下降，所以大分子儀器常在偵測器前加後加速。~Arriving ions strike a microchannel plate, whose channel walls emit secondary electrons that multiply under a bias of a few kilovolts; a two-plate chevron stack gives a gain of about 10⁶ and output pulses narrower than 1 ns. Pulses are either recorded by a time-to-digital converter (TDC) as single-ion events in 25–100 ps bins or digitised as full waveforms by an analogue-to-digital converter (ADC) running at several gigasamples per second and summed; the TDC offers fine timing and low noise but counts at most once per bin per pulse, while the ADC has more dynamic range but baseline noise. MCP detection efficiency depends on impact velocity and drops markedly for slow heavy ions, so large-molecule instruments often post-accelerate ions in front of the detector.
units.model: 增益 10⁶ 時每個離子給 1.6×10⁻¹³ C，若在約 1 ns 內輸出，平均電流 0.16 mA，在 50 Ω 上約 8 mV。反射器儀器 m/z 1000 的 t = 25.75 µs，R = 20 000 對應峰寬 Δt = t/(2R) ≈ 0.64 ns：50 ps 的 TDC 時間格在半高寬內有約 13 格，5 GS/s 的 ADC（每點 200 ps）只有約 3 點。速度比較：m/z 1000 在 20 kV 時 6.2×10⁴ m/s，100 kDa 時僅 6.2×10³ m/s，撞擊速度低一個數量級。~At a gain of 10⁶ each ion yields 1.6×10⁻¹³ C, and delivered within about 1 ns that is 0.16 mA, roughly 8 mV across 50 Ω. In the reflectron instrument m/z 1000 has t = 25.75 µs, and R = 20 000 means a peak width Δt = t/(2R) ≈ 0.64 ns: a 50 ps TDC bin places about 13 bins across the half-maximum width, while a 5 GS/s ADC at 200 ps per point gives only about 3 points. For velocity, m/z 1000 at 20 kV travels 6.2×10⁴ m/s but a 100 kDa ion only 6.2×10³ m/s, an order of magnitude lower impact speed.
units.verify: 以極低離子流記錄單離子脈衝高度分布，確認 MCP 增益與鑑別閾值設定，並每月追蹤增益隨累計電荷的下降；以脈衝產生器注入已知間隔的雙脈衝量 TDC 或 ADC 的時間解析與非線性；以不同質量的已知樣品比較偵測效率，必要時調整後加速電壓並記錄。~Record the pulse-height distribution of single ions at very low ion flux to confirm MCP gain and discriminator threshold, tracking gain loss with accumulated charge monthly; inject double pulses of known spacing from a pulse generator to measure the time resolution and nonlinearity of the TDC or ADC; compare detection efficiency on known samples across masses and adjust and log the post-acceleration voltage when needed.
units.failure: MCP 在高離子流下長期使用，通道局部增益耗盡，強峰位置出現靈敏度凹陷，該質量區的定量偏低且同位素比例失真；鑑別閾值設得過高，增益下降後一部分單離子脈衝低於閾值被丟掉，整體靈敏度在數週內緩慢下降而沒有人發現。~Prolonged use at high ion flux depletes channel gain locally, so the detector shows a sensitivity dip where strong peaks land, under-quantifying that mass region and distorting isotope ratios; a discriminator set too high discards single-ion pulses that fall below it as gain declines, so overall sensitivity sinks slowly over weeks without anyone noticing.
units.misconception: MCP 對所有質量的離子偵測效率都相同。~An MCP detects ions of every mass with the same efficiency.

units.anchor: t₀、k 校正與飛行管溫度~t₀, k calibration and flight-tube temperature
units.title: 質量校正與 ppm 誤差來源~Mass calibration and sources of ppm error
units.mechanism: 實際儀器以 t = t₀ + k·√(m/z) 校正：k 包含飛行長度與加速電壓，t₀ 包含觸發、纜線與電子延遲；高精度時還會加入高階項修正場的非理想。校正後的誤差主要來自兩種漂移：飛行管熱膨脹讓 L 改變，加速與反射器高壓的相對漂移讓 U 改變；由 m ∝ U·t²/L² 可知長度的相對變化在質量上加倍，而電壓的相對變化一比一進入質量。因此高解析儀器使用低膨脹材料與溫控飛行管、ppm 級穩定的高壓電源，並以持續注入的鎖定質量離子即時修正。~Real instruments calibrate with t = t₀ + k·√(m/z), where k contains flight length and acceleration voltage and t₀ contains trigger, cable and electronic delays; high-accuracy work adds higher-order terms for non-ideal fields. After calibration the errors come mainly from two drifts: thermal expansion of the flight tube changes L, and relative drift of the acceleration and reflectron high voltages changes U; since m ∝ U·t²/L², a relative length change doubles in mass while a relative voltage change enters mass one to one. High-resolution instruments therefore use low-expansion, temperature-controlled flight tubes, ppm-stable high-voltage supplies and a continuously infused lock-mass ion for real-time correction.
units.model: 反射器儀器有效長度 1.6 m、U = 20 kV：k = 1.6×√(u/(2eU)) ≈ 0.8144 µs/√Da，t₀ = 0.150 µs。以 m/z 300 與 1500 兩點校正（t = 14.257 與 31.693 µs）得回 k 與 t₀；m/z 1000 的 t = 25.905 µs。鋁管升溫 1 K（23 ppm/K）讓飛行段長 23 ppm，舊校正讀成 1000.046，誤差 +46 ppm；改用熱膨脹 1.2 ppm/K 的低膨脹合金只剩 +2.4 ppm。高壓上漂 10 ppm 給 −10 ppm。若忽略 t₀ 只用一點過原點校正，誤差高達約 2100 ppm。~For the reflectron instrument with an effective length of 1.6 m and U = 20 kV, k = 1.6×√(u/(2eU)) ≈ 0.8144 µs/√Da and t₀ = 0.150 µs. Two-point calibration at m/z 300 and 1500 (t = 14.257 and 31.693 µs) recovers k and t₀, and m/z 1000 arrives at t = 25.905 µs. Warming an aluminium tube by 1 K (23 ppm/K) lengthens the flight by 23 ppm, so the old calibration reads 1000.046, a +46 ppm error; a low-expansion alloy at 1.2 ppm/K leaves only +2.4 ppm. A 10 ppm upward high-voltage drift gives −10 ppm. Ignoring t₀ with a one-point calibration through the origin errs by about 2100 ppm.
units.verify: 以至少五個涵蓋工作範圍的校正離子做擬合，記錄殘差的均方根，應在 1 ppm 等級；關掉鎖定質量修正後連續 8 小時每 10 分鐘量一個參考離子，畫質量誤差對飛行管溫度與高壓監測讀值的散佈圖，求出 ppm/K 與 ppm/ppm 係數並與模型比較；再開啟鎖定質量確認修正後的誤差帶寬。~Fit at least five calibrant ions spanning the working range and log the RMS residual, which should be at the 1 ppm level; with lock-mass correction off, measure a reference ion every 10 minutes for 8 hours and plot mass error against flight-tube temperature and high-voltage monitor readings to extract ppm/K and ppm/ppm coefficients for comparison with the model; then switch the lock mass on and confirm the corrected error band.
units.failure: 空調週期讓實驗室溫度擺動 ±0.5 K，未溫控的鋁飛行管產生 ±23 ppm 的週期性質量誤差，代謝物以 5 ppm 窗口搜尋資料庫時一半以上的正確化合物被排除；鎖定質量離子被樣品中的同質量干擾污染，修正把整段資料往錯誤方向拉偏。~Air-conditioning cycles swing the laboratory ±0.5 K and an uncontrolled aluminium flight tube produces periodic ±23 ppm mass errors, so a metabolite database search with a 5 ppm window rejects more than half of the correct compounds; a lock-mass ion contaminated by an isobaric sample interference pulls the whole data set the wrong way.
units.misconception: 校正一次之後，飛行時間質譜的質量準確度就會一直維持。~After one calibration a TOF mass spectrometer keeps its mass accuracy indefinitely.

units.anchor: 質心統計與死時間飽和~Centroid statistics and dead-time saturation
units.title: 計數統計、死時間與動態範圍~Counting statistics, dead time and dynamic range
units.mechanism: 質量準確度不只取決於校正，也取決於每個峰的質心能定得多準：對高斯峰，質心的標準差約為 (FWHM/2.355)/√N，N 是構成該峰的離子數，所以弱峰的質量本來就不準。TDC 系統在每次推送中每個時間格最多記一個離子，當平均到達數 μ 接近 1 時事件被漏記，觀察到的機率為 1 − e^(−μ)，強峰被壓扁、質心往早到的一側偏移；可用泊松修正 μ = −ln(1 − f) 還原，但在 f 接近 1 時失效。動態範圍因此受限於推送次數與飽和，ADC 或混合式採集與自動增益控制用來擴展。~Mass accuracy depends not only on calibration but on how well each peak centroid is defined: for a Gaussian peak the centroid standard deviation is about (FWHM/2.355)/√N with N the number of ions in the peak, so weak peaks are intrinsically less accurate. A TDC system records at most one ion per time bin per push, so as the mean arrival number μ approaches 1 events are lost and the observed probability is 1 − e^(−μ); strong peaks are flattened and their centroids shift toward earlier arrival. Poisson correction μ = −ln(1 − f) restores them but fails as f approaches 1, so dynamic range is limited by push count and saturation, and ADC or hybrid acquisition with automatic gain control extends it.
units.model: R = 20 000、m/z 1000 時 FWHM = 0.050 Da：N = 100 個離子的質心標準差 = 0.050/(2.355×√100) ≈ 2.1 mDa ≈ 2.1 ppm；N = 10 000 時降到 0.21 ppm。TDC 死時間：某峰每次推送平均 μ = 0.5 個離子，只記到 1 − e^(−0.5) = 0.393，少 21%；μ = 2 時只記到 0.865，少 57%。每張譜累加 3000 次推送時，單一時間格最多 3000 計數，強弱峰的可用動態範圍約 3.5 個數量級。~At R = 20 000 and m/z 1000 the FWHM is 0.050 Da: with N = 100 ions the centroid standard deviation is 0.050/(2.355×√100) ≈ 2.1 mDa ≈ 2.1 ppm, falling to 0.21 ppm at N = 10 000. TDC dead time: a peak averaging μ = 0.5 ions per push is recorded at 1 − e^(−0.5) = 0.393, 21% low; at μ = 2 only 0.865 is recorded, 57% low. With 3000 pushes summed per spectrum a single bin holds at most 3000 counts, giving about 3.5 decades of usable dynamic range between strong and weak peaks.
units.verify: 以同一化合物做 10⁻³ 到 10 倍的稀釋序列，畫觀察計數對濃度的對數圖，找出開始偏離線性的濃度，並比較開啟與關閉泊松修正的差異；在不同強度下重複量同一峰的質量 30 次，確認質量誤差的標準差依 1/√N 下降；以已知同位素比例的化合物檢查強峰飽和時 M+1/M 比值是否被扭曲。~Run a dilution series of one compound from 10⁻³ to 10 times and plot observed counts against concentration on log axes to find where linearity breaks, comparing results with and without Poisson correction; measure the mass of one peak 30 times at several intensities and confirm that the standard deviation of the mass error falls as 1/√N; use a compound of known isotope ratio to check whether M+1/M is distorted when the main peak saturates.
units.failure: 主成分峰在 TDC 中飽和，峰頂被壓平、質心往低質量偏移 5 ppm 以上，而 M+1 同位素峰未飽和，同位素比例被高估，以此推算的元素組成錯誤；為了看見痕量雜質把離子流調高，結果所有強峰都飽和，定量線性只剩一個數量級。~A dominant peak saturating the TDC is flattened and its centroid shifts low by more than 5 ppm while the unsaturated M+1 isotope peak is not, so the isotope ratio is overestimated and the elemental composition derived from it is wrong; raising the ion flux to reveal trace impurities saturates every strong peak and leaves only one decade of quantitative linearity.
units.misconception: 峰越強，量到的質量就一定越準。~The stronger the peak, the more accurate its measured mass must be.

units.anchor: 正交推送器與離子源介面~Orthogonal pusher and ion-source interface
units.title: MALDI、ESI 與正交加速的整合~Integrating MALDI, ESI and orthogonal acceleration
units.mechanism: 飛行時間分析器需要脈衝式的起點：MALDI 本身就是雷射脈衝，以 337 或 355 nm 雷射在基質晶體上每秒數百到上萬發，適合點樣與組織成像；ESI 產生連續離子流，必須先經離子導引與碰撞冷卻，再以正交加速推送器把一段離子束側向推入飛行管。正交加速的工作週期等於推送器長度除以每個推送週期內離子束前進的距離，與 √(m/z) 成正比；離子束的橫向速度散布在推送場中造成轉向時間 Δt = 2mΔv/(qE)，這是反射器無法修正的計時項。與液相層析耦合時，譜圖速率需在每個層析峰內取足夠點數。~A time-of-flight analyser needs a pulsed start: MALDI is inherently pulsed, firing a 337 or 355 nm laser at matrix crystals hundreds to tens of thousands of times per second, suited to spotted samples and tissue imaging; ESI produces a continuous ion stream that must pass through ion guides and collisional cooling before an orthogonal-acceleration pusher kicks a segment of the beam sideways into the flight tube. The orthogonal duty cycle equals the pusher length divided by the distance the beam advances per push period and scales with √(m/z); the beam's transverse velocity spread in the push field creates a turnaround time Δt = 2mΔv/(qE), a timing term the reflectron cannot correct. Coupled to liquid chromatography, the spectral rate must give enough points across every chromatographic peak.
units.model: 離子束能量 10 eV、m/z 1000 時束速 1389 m/s；推送頻率 10 kHz（週期 100 µs）內束流前進 0.139 m，推送器接收 30 mm，工作週期 30/139 ≈ 21.6%；m/z 100 束速 4393 m/s，工作週期只有 6.8%。冷卻後橫向速度散布 Δv = 20 m/s、推送場 4×10⁵ V/m：Δt = 2×1000×1.66×10⁻²⁷×20/(1.602×10⁻¹⁹×4×10⁵) ≈ 1.04 ns，在 t = 25.75 µs 的儀器上把 R 限制在約 12 400。層析峰寬 3 s 取 10 點需 3.3 譜/s，每譜累加 3000 次推送。~With a 10 eV beam an m/z 1000 ion moves at 1389 m/s, so in a 10 kHz push period of 100 µs the beam advances 0.139 m and a 30 mm pusher gives a duty cycle of 30/139 ≈ 21.6%; at m/z 100 the beam moves 4393 m/s and the duty cycle is only 6.8%. With a cooled transverse spread Δv = 20 m/s and a push field of 4×10⁵ V/m, Δt = 2×1000×1.66×10⁻²⁷×20/(1.602×10⁻¹⁹×4×10⁵) ≈ 1.04 ns, which limits R to about 12 400 on the t = 25.75 µs instrument. Taking 10 points across a 3 s chromatographic peak needs 3.3 spectra per second, each summing 3000 pushes.
units.verify: 以等莫耳的多質量混合物持續注入，比較各質量的相對靈敏度與 √(m/z) 預測的工作週期趨勢；改變碰撞冷卻氣壓與推送場，量測解析力變化以確認轉向時間項的貢獻；以標準層析分離測試每個峰的取樣點數與峰面積重複性，確認譜圖速率設定足夠。~Infuse an equimolar multi-mass mixture and compare relative sensitivities with the √(m/z) duty-cycle trend; vary collisional-cooling pressure and push field and measure the change in resolving power to confirm the turnaround contribution; run a standard chromatographic separation to check points per peak and peak-area repeatability, confirming that the spectral rate is adequate.
units.failure: 為了提高解析力把推送頻率調低卻沒有調整離子導引的累積，低質量離子的工作週期更差，小分子代謝物的靈敏度掉到原來的三分之一；推送頻率太高使重離子尚未到達下一次推送就開始，前一譜的 m/z 3000 離子落在下一譜的低質量區，形成假的低質量峰。~Lowering the push rate for resolving power without adjusting ion-guide accumulation worsens the duty cycle for low-mass ions, cutting small-metabolite sensitivity to a third; pushing too fast starts the next spectrum before heavy ions arrive, so m/z 3000 ions from one push land in the low-mass region of the next spectrum as false low-mass peaks.
units.misconception: 正交加速對所有質量的離子利用率都相同。~Orthogonal acceleration uses ions of every mass with equal efficiency.

units.anchor: 解析力、質量準確度與線性的驗收表~Acceptance table of resolution, accuracy and linearity
units.title: 儀器驗收與工程交接~Instrument acceptance and engineering handoff
units.mechanism: 飛行時間質譜儀的驗收把前面的模型轉成固定測試：以標準品量各質量段的解析力（FWHM 定義），以多點校正與長時間鎖定質量量測驗證 ppm 準確度與漂移，以稀釋序列驗證線性與死時間修正，以已知同位素比例驗證偵測器飽和，以 MCP 單離子脈衝高度驗證增益，並以層析測試驗證取樣速率。交接紀錄須包含校正係數與殘差、飛行管溫度與高壓監測趨勢、MCP 電壓與累計計數、反射器與推送器電壓、鎖定質量設定，以及各項允收值，使任何一項劣化都能追溯。~Acceptance of a time-of-flight mass spectrometer turns the earlier models into fixed tests: standards measure FWHM resolving power across mass ranges, multipoint calibration and long lock-mass runs verify ppm accuracy and drift, dilution series verify linearity and dead-time correction, known isotope ratios verify detector saturation, single-ion MCP pulse heights verify gain, and chromatographic tests verify sampling rate. The handoff record must contain calibration coefficients and residuals, flight-tube temperature and high-voltage trends, MCP voltage and accumulated counts, reflectron and pusher voltages, lock-mass settings and each allowance, so that any degradation can be traced.
units.model: 驗收範例：m/z 1000 的 FWHM 0.048 Da，R ≈ 20 800，高於 20 000 允收值；五點校正殘差 0.6 ppm RMS；鎖定質量開啟時 24 小時質量誤差 ±1.5 ppm，關閉時隨飛行管溫度變化 ±0.1 K 擺動 ±0.24 ppm（低膨脹合金 1.2 ppm/K）；稀釋序列在泊松修正後 3.2 個數量級內偏差小於 10%；計算的 M+1/M = 0.55，量得 0.53，偏差 −3.6%，低於 5% 允收值。~Example acceptance: the FWHM at m/z 1000 is 0.048 Da, R ≈ 20 800, above the 20 000 allowance; five-point calibration residuals are 0.6 ppm RMS; with lock mass on the 24-hour mass error is ±1.5 ppm, and with it off a ±0.1 K flight-tube swing moves the mass by ±0.24 ppm for a 1.2 ppm/K low-expansion alloy; the dilution series stays within 10% over 3.2 decades after Poisson correction; the calculated M+1/M is 0.55 and the measured value 0.53, a −3.6% deviation inside the 5% allowance.
units.verify: 依固定順序執行：真空與高壓穩定、MCP 單離子脈衝高度、校正與殘差、各質量段解析力、8–24 小時質量漂移（開與關鎖定質量）、稀釋序列線性、同位素比例、層析取樣測試；每項與模型值並列於驗收表，超出允收值時記錄原因並重做，最後把設定與趨勢圖一起交接並排定下次驗證。~Execute in a fixed order: vacuum and high-voltage stability, single-ion MCP pulse height, calibration and residuals, resolving power across mass ranges, 8–24-hour mass drift with lock mass on and off, dilution-series linearity, isotope ratios and a chromatographic sampling test; enter each result beside its model value in the acceptance table, record the cause and repeat any item outside its allowance, and hand over the settings with trend plots and a scheduled next verification.
units.failure: 只在單一質量驗收解析力，使用者在 m/z 200 以下的小分子區解析力只有一半卻不知情，同質量干擾無法分開而被判為單一化合物；交接紀錄沒有 MCP 增益趨勢，半年後靈敏度下降 70% 才被發現，期間所有低濃度樣品都被報為未檢出。~Accepting resolving power at a single mass leaves users unaware that resolving power below m/z 200 is only half as good, so isobaric interferences cannot be separated and are reported as single compounds; with no MCP gain trend in the handoff record, a 70% loss of sensitivity is discovered only after six months, during which every low-level sample was reported as not detected.
units.misconception: 解析力只要在一個質量驗收合格，整個質量範圍就都合格。~If resolving power passes at one mass, it passes across the whole mass range.

example: 反射式飛行時間質量量測練習：有效飛行長度 1.6 m、U = 20 kV，k = 0.8144 µs/√Da、t₀ = 0.150 µs，m/z 1000 的到達時間 t = 0.150 + 0.8144×√1000 ≈ 25.905 µs。總計時展寬 0.62 ns 時 R = 25 755/(2×0.62) ≈ 20 800，FWHM ≈ 0.048 Da。未知峰由 2500 個離子組成，質心不確定度 0.048/(2.355×√2500) ≈ 0.41 mDa ≈ 0.41 ppm。量測期間飛行管升溫 0.3 K：鋁管 23 ppm/K 會讓質量偏 2×23×0.3 ≈ +13.8 ppm，低膨脹合金 1.2 ppm/K 只偏 +0.72 ppm；高壓同時上漂 2 ppm 再貢獻 −2 ppm。以鎖定質量即時修正後總誤差約 √(0.41² + 0.5²) ≈ 0.65 ppm（0.5 ppm 為鎖定修正殘差的假設值）。若該峰在 TDC 中每次推送平均 μ = 0.5 個離子而未做泊松修正，強度低估 21% 且質心偏早，必須降低離子流或啟用修正。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。~Reflectron TOF mass-measurement exercise: with an effective flight length of 1.6 m and U = 20 kV, k = 0.8144 µs/√Da and t₀ = 0.150 µs, so m/z 1000 arrives at t = 0.150 + 0.8144×√1000 ≈ 25.905 µs. A total timing spread of 0.62 ns gives R = 25 755/(2×0.62) ≈ 20 800 and a FWHM of about 0.048 Da. An unknown peak built from 2500 ions has a centroid uncertainty of 0.048/(2.355×√2500) ≈ 0.41 mDa ≈ 0.41 ppm. During the measurement the flight tube warms 0.3 K: an aluminium tube at 23 ppm/K would shift the mass by 2×23×0.3 ≈ +13.8 ppm, a 1.2 ppm/K low-expansion alloy only +0.72 ppm, and a simultaneous 2 ppm high-voltage rise adds −2 ppm. After real-time lock-mass correction the total error is about √(0.41² + 0.5²) ≈ 0.65 ppm, taking 0.5 ppm as the assumed lock-mass residual. If the peak averages μ = 0.5 ions per push in the TDC without Poisson correction, its intensity is 21% low and its centroid early, so the ion flux must be reduced or correction enabled. Values are teaching assumptions, not any instrument's specification.
history: 1946 年賓州大學的 William Stephens 提出飛行時間質量分析的構想，1955 年 Bendix 公司的 Wiley 與 McLaren 發表雙段加速的空間聚焦與時間延遲聚焦，奠定商用儀器的基礎。1973 年 Mamyrin 在列寧格勒提出反射器，大幅提升解析力；1980 年代後期 Karas 與 Hillenkamp 以及島津製作所的田中耕一發展出基質輔助雷射脫附游離（MALDI），田中與電灑游離的 John Fenn 共同獲得 2002 年諾貝爾化學獎；正交加速讓連續的電灑離子源也能接上飛行時間分析器，今日的四極—飛行時間與多次反射式儀器已是蛋白質體與代謝體研究的主力。本課只重建公開的物理與工程邏輯。~In 1946 William Stephens of the University of Pennsylvania proposed time-of-flight mass analysis, and in 1955 Wiley and McLaren of the Bendix Corporation published two-stage space focusing and time-lag focusing, the basis of commercial instruments. In 1973 Mamyrin in Leningrad proposed the reflectron, greatly raising resolving power; in the late 1980s Karas and Hillenkamp, and Koichi Tanaka at Shimadzu, developed matrix-assisted laser desorption/ionisation (MALDI), and Tanaka shared the 2002 Nobel Prize in Chemistry with John Fenn of electrospray ionisation; orthogonal acceleration let continuous electrospray sources feed time-of-flight analysers, and today quadrupole–time-of-flight and multi-reflecting instruments are workhorses of proteomics and metabolomics. This course reconstructs only public physics and engineering logic.
